arms.A: shortest feasible distance; energy logged only
arms.B: minimum predicted mission energy; calibrated physics estimator
arms.C: minimum predicted mission energy; served physics-plus-XGBoost with documented fallback

strata.surface: single qualified surface on both ramps; the proposal's second surface is not qualified, so the pilot executes 6 strata instead of 12 (90 one-way missions instead of 180)

round_trip.note: payload changes only at fresh-world initialization in the frozen fixture; round-trip energy and reserve are chained arithmetically across the two legs

randomization.method: seeded shuffle of triplet-internal arm order, stratum order, and triplet order; identical conditions within each triplet

fallback_demonstration.condition: serving endpoint unreachable at planning time
fallback_demonstration.expectation: documented physics fallback selection; mission completes or is rejected per feasibility

criteria.motion_and_task_completion: all missions complete or enter the expected controlled failure state; zero collisions, ramp departures, or hard-limit violations
criteria.route_coordination: RMF itinerary, selected ramp, Nav2 goals, and observed trajectory agree in every run
criteria.reserve_and_deadline: no battery-reserve violation; all routes meet the frozen deadlines
criteria.legitimate_outcomes: prediction improvement without route-energy benefit is a recorded result, not a failure

scope: simulation comparative demonstration over modeled energy; no physical battery-saving claim
